home.heroHeading: People, Business and Possibility Across Africa
home.heroSubheading: Relocation Africa helps organisations, global mobility teams and relocating families navigate immigration, destination services and workforce mobility across Africa, so people can arrive ready to live, work and thrive.
home.introBody:
Moving people across Africa calls for more than a checklist. It calls for local understanding, trusted coordination and support that recognises the person behind every assignment.

Relocation Africa brings together destination services, immigration, research, remuneration and training to help organisations make confident mobility decisions and help assignees feel at home sooner.

sections.heading: Local Knowledge
sections.description: We pair regional perspective with in-country insight, helping clients make informed decisions in complex and fast-changing markets.

sections.heading: Personal Support
sections.description: Every relocation affects a person, a family and a career. We make space for the practical and human realities of change.

sections.heading: Accountability
sections.description: We take ownership of what has been entrusted to us, communicate clearly and work to earn trust at every stage.

about.metaTitle: About Relocation Africa | African Mobility Specialists
about.metaDescription: Learn how Relocation Africa supports employers and relocating people with practical, people-centred mobility services across Africa.
about.heroHeading: Built for Africa. Focused on People.
about.heroSubheading: Relocation Africa helps global organisations and relocating people make confident moves across Africa through local expertise, accountable service and genuine human support.
about.introBody:
Relocation Africa was built on a simple belief: mobility works best when people feel informed, supported and able to get on with their lives and work.

Our integrated services bring together destination support, immigration, research, remuneration and training. We help global HR and mobility teams navigate the operational complexity of African assignments while keeping the assignee experience in view.

sections.heading: Embrace Change
sections.description: We respond to change with curiosity, innovation and practical action.

sections.heading: Uncompromising Ethics
sections.description: We build trust through responsible decisions, honest communication and professional conduct.

sections.heading: Consider the Person
sections.description: We listen with empathy and recognise that every relocation experience is different.

sections.heading: I Do It, I Own It
sections.description: We take accountability for our commitments and follow through.

careers.metaTitle: Careers at Relocation Africa | Join Our African Mobility Network
careers.metaDescription: Explore current career opportunities with Relocation Africa and help people and organisations move confidently across Africa.
careers.heroSubheading: Join a team that helps people, families and organisations navigate change across Africa with local knowledge, empathy and professionalism.
careers.introBody:
Every successful relocation relies on people who know their communities, communicate with care and take ownership of the details. At Relocation Africa, our work helps assignees and their families settle into new environments with greater confidence.

We value practical expertise, cultural awareness and a willingness to support people through moments that matter. Whether you work in destination services, immigration, research, remuneration or operations, your contribution helps make mobility more human.

sections.heading: Purposeful Work
sections.description: Help people and organisations make important transitions with confidence.

sections.heading: African Perspective
sections.description: Build expertise across diverse markets, cultures and communities.

sections.heading: Professional Growth
sections.description: Learn from experienced specialists and contribute to evolving mobility solutions.

sections.heading: Shared Ownership
sections.description: Work with people who value accountability, respect and collaboration.

contact.metaTitle: Contact Relocation Africa | Talk to Our Mobility Team
contact.metaDescription: Get in touch with Relocation Africa to discuss destination services, immigration, research, remuneration or training for your African assignments.
contact.heroSubheading: Tell us about the move you are planning and we will point you to the right specialist. Whether you are relocating one employee or shaping a regional mobility programme, we are glad to help.
contact.introBody:
Share as much detail as you can about the destination, the timing and the people involved, and we will come back with practical next steps.

If your enquiry relates to an assignment already under way, please include the assignee's destination so we can route it to the right local team.

locations.metaTitle: Our African Locations & Coverage | Relocation Africa
locations.metaDescription: Find Relocation Africa's offices and the African countries where we coordinate relocation, immigration and destination services.
locations.heroSubheading: Local knowledge changes everything. Our African network helps clients understand the realities on the ground, coordinate each stage of a move and respond with clarity when plans change.
locations.introBody:
Relocation Africa coordinates assignments across a wide range of African destinations, combining regional oversight with in-country delivery.

If a destination you need is not listed, speak to us. Coverage is arranged around each programme's requirements.
